caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Mar 27–Apr 3, with this week's comics in one place.

On the trampoline, take turns with the kids and land with softly bent knees. Before tackling Sydney's hills, try 10 slow heel raises on a step. Loading a wheelbarrow over the wheel, with half loads and more trips, can ease the strain on your back. On a long flight, a travel pillow can support the sides of your neck.

Scroll back through the week for the full comics. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios, chiropractors and remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
